brief_rationale: The trajectory terminated after a single doctor turn with a runtime error, during which the doctor only issued a brief acknowledgment statement ('情况紧急，我立刻调取你家人在联合医疗网络的资料，同时请你现在做几件事。') without providing any substantive emergency guidance. All responsibility chain items requiring emergency recognition, red flag assessment, handoff plan, transfer precautions, fasting instructions, and essential information elicitation were omitted. These are serious omissions given the time-critical nature of multiple stab wounds with ongoing bleeding and altered mental status.
